title: Ghost inbox (per-verb)
description: Same contract as actions.schema.json, but every verb carries only its own arguments. The flat version guaranteed the JSON parsed and left the model free to put a position in `block` or a destination in `to`; this makes those ungrammatical. oneOf rather than if/then because llama.cpp's schema-to-GBNF converter, which Ollama uses, does not support if/then.
